description: Turns earlier results (resultIds from http_request, run_request, run_collection, verify_api_effect, db_assert; kept 30 minutes) into a report: Markdown, a self-contained HTML page and JUnit XML in .signoff/evidence/<time>/ (git-ignored), plus a short Markdown summary to paste into a pull request, e.g. "Verified by SignOff Studio: 14/14 API checks, 3/3 DB checks".
